howItWorks.title: One source of jobs: Expedion orders
howItWorks.intro: No marketplace to browse, no goods auctions. Every job is a real, packed, insured Expedion shipment that our own fleet could not take.

step1.title: A job is posted automatically
step1.desc: A client ordered on Expedion and no pool driver is free. Route, size, photos and deadline are already in the listing.

step2.title: You bid your price
step2.desc: Reverse auction: the lowest serious offer leads. Bid what the run is worth to you, all-in.

step3.title: The client picks, or Expedion does
step3.desc: At closing, the winning carrier is booked instantly. Pickup slot is already reserved with the auction house.

step4.title: Deliver, one status feed
step4.desc: Your updates feed the same tracking the buyer sees in Expedion. Proof of delivery in, payment out within 7 days.

platform.title: Open a tab, bid. Nothing to install.
platform.intro: Expeditoo is built as a modern web app (Next.js). For a carrier business, that choice is deliberate:

point1.title: Works everywhere, instantly.
point1.desc: Cab phone, depot PC, dispatcher's laptop: same URL, no app store, no version to update.

point2.title: Live auctions.
point2.desc: Bids refresh server-side the second they land — what you see is the real state of the board.

point3.title: Fast on weak networks.
point3.desc: Pages are rendered on the server (SSR), so the board loads readable in under a second on an aire d'autoroute.

point4.title: Easy to share.
point4.desc: A job is a link. Forward it to a colleague, they see it without an account.

platform.note: Your clients, on their side, use the Expedion mobile app (Flutter, iOS + Android).

q1.question: How do I track my shipment?
q1.answer: You can track your shipment by going to the "Deliveries" section in your dashboard. Click on the specific shipment to view its current status and timeline.

q2.question: How does the auction bidding work?
q2.answer: When you place a bid, you are committing to buy the item if you win. The auction ends when the timer runs out. If a bid is placed in the last few minutes, the timer may extend (soft close) to allow other bidders to respond.

q3.question: Can I cancel a shipment?
q3.answer: You can cancel a shipment request as long as it hasn't been picked up by a driver. Go to the shipment details page and look for the "Cancel" option. Cancellation fees may apply if a driver has already been assigned.

q4.question: How do I contact a seller?
q4.answer: You can message a seller directly from the item listing page or from your "Messages" dashboard. All communication should stay within the platform for your safety.

q5.question: What payment methods are accepted?
q5.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards via our secure payment partner, Stripe. We do not store your card details directly on our servers.
